entry.title: 🔐 Login Keepalive (updated, v6)
entry.summary: Checks configured service logins, refreshes access where supported, and alerts when you need to reconnect. Includes a YouTube access check after connecting the YouTube Uploader skill.

entry.title: ▶️ YouTube Uploader (updated, v3)
entry.summary: Let Claude upload videos when you ask, with separate channel profiles, thumbnail preparation, scheduled releases and safe resume after interruptions. Connect your own YouTube account once.

entry.title: 🧠 Claude + Codex Setup (updated, v4)
entry.summary: The setup Jesse runs on his Mac: Claude Code and Codex share the same skills, memory and standing instructions, with nightly private GitHub backup, safe auto-updates that roll back bad versions, a login-expiry watchdog and a bounded Claude/Codex handoff tool.

entry.title: 📣 Meta Ads Manager (updated, v2)
entry.summary: Run Facebook/Instagram ads from the command line: duplicate campaigns, change budgets, pause and resume, and pull cost-per-lead reports. Every change is shown as a plan first and only applied when you confirm.

entry.title: ✨ Sculpt Photo Editor (updated, v2)
entry.summary: A browser app for photographers: AI-assisted culling, Lightroom-style colour profiles baked into GPU LUTs, retouching, and delivery straight to Pixieset galleries.

entry.title: 🖥️ Headless Mac Setup (updated, v2)
entry.summary: The full checklist for running Claude on a Mac mini you don't sit at: installs, daemon PATH fixes, macOS privacy permissions (TCC) and remote-access checks.

entry.title: ✅ Project Wrap-Up Checklist (updated, v2)
entry.summary: Before Claude calls anything 'done', it checks for things that will break silently later (expired logins, jobs that stopped running, untested cron paths), hardens them, saves reusable skills and writes notes to memory.

entry.title: 🧰 Claude Shelf (updated, v3)
entry.summary: The skill behind this site. One command publishes anything you build with Claude: it strips secrets and private info, builds a zip and install prompt, updates the feed and pushes to GitHub Pages.

entry.title: 🩺 Self-Healing Automations (updated, v2)
entry.summary: A framework that checks every stage of a recurring automation and repairs failures itself. It does a simple fix first, then lets Claude attempt a repair (kept only if the check goes green), and only pings you if both fail.

entry.title: 🎞️ Daily Instagram Reels
entry.summary: Renders a branded 9:16 reel plus caption every day from photo albums and film clips, a week ahead, into a synced folder ready to post.

entry.title: 🌃 Night Out 3D Game
entry.summary: A GTA-style night out in the browser: drivable Ferrari, animated character, neon city with enterable pubs and clubs, traffic and pedestrians, a minimap, procedural audio, and a drunk meter that ends badly at 100%.

entry.title: 📸 Jesse Chance Photography Website
entry.summary: Jesse's business site, rebuilt with Claude as a fast static site with no framework or CMS: galleries, films, packages, venue pages and a booking form.

entry.title: 💍 Wedding Jobs Bot
entry.summary: Reads booking emails from Studio Ninja, logs each wedding job to a Google Sheet, works out team pay from the package, and builds a ready-to-send WhatsApp message for the crew.

entry.title: 🚤 Boat Weather Forecast
entry.summary: Grades the next 7 mornings as GREAT/GOOD/MARGINAL/NO for boating, using two weather models for wind and gusts, swell and chop, plus Bureau of Meteorology coastal warnings. It can email you when a good day is coming.

entry.title: ✉️ Gmail Assistant
entry.summary: Search, read, summarise and draft replies in your Gmail from the command line. Claude can write anything, but nothing sends until you explicitly confirm.

entry.title: 📺 Tap List TV Pranks
entry.summary: Mess with a bar's tap-list TV screens in real time: scramble every word, handwrite a message across the screen, or put a photo up.

entry.title: 🍺 Tap List TV Display
entry.summary: A tap-list screen for a TV or Fire Stick that auto-refreshes and rotates pages, plus a dead-simple phone editor for the brewer, a Cloudflare Worker backend and a Fire TV app that boots straight into it.

entry.title: 📍 Instagram to Google Business
entry.summary: A Zapier recipe that mirrors every new Instagram post to your Google Business Profile as a 'What's new' post, with hashtags stripped and Reels skipped. Good for local SEO.

entry.title: 💅 Luxe Beauty Website
entry.summary: A full local-business site built with Claude for a beauty salon: services and prices, aftercare guides, SEO pages for each treatment and suburb, and a gallery.

entry.title: 📝 Simple Memory
entry.summary: The simplest long-term memory for agents: one command to save a decision, one to search past notes. Shared by Claude and Codex.

entry.title: 💾 Project Backup
entry.summary: At the start of any project, Claude initialises git, writes a sensible .gitignore (keeps secrets and huge files out), creates a PRIVATE GitHub repo and registers it for nightly automatic backup.

entry.title: ⚡ Tesla CAN-Bus Dashboard
entry.summary: Decodes 2,700 signals off a Tesla Model 3's vehicle bus: individual cell voltages, motor and inverter temps, real pack capacity, power analytics, all in a live web dashboard.

entry.title: 🟦 Square Price Sync
entry.summary: Keeps your Square booking prices in sync with your website: reads both, shows the differences, and pushes changes only when you confirm.

entry.title: 🎲 AnotherLife Life Simulator
entry.summary: A text-based life sim. You're born at random somewhere in the world and live one year at a time with careers, fame, storylines that pay off decades later, and premium modes like Mafia, Royalty and Fighter. Runs in a browser, builds for Android.

entry.title: 🔍 Browser Tester
entry.summary: Claude drives a real headless Chrome so it can screenshot every screen of your web app, catch JavaScript errors, and spot bugs that only show up on screen. No Playwright or Puppeteer needed.

entry.title: 😎 Luke's Dating Page
entry.summary: A joke 'dating profile' website made for a mate. Proof you can make a ridiculous, polished site for a laugh in one evening.

entry.title: 🎬 AI Video Pipeline
entry.summary: Research a topic, fact-check every claim, write the script in your voice, and chunk it for voice cloning. Later stages render avatar video with motion graphics and QC it visually.

entry.title: 📥 Video Transcriber
entry.summary: Paste a Google Drive share link, any public video URL, or a local file path, and Claude downloads it and transcribes it offline. It's for when your chat app can't upload files.

entry.title: 🦾 Jarvis Voice Assistant
entry.summary: A JARVIS/Batcomputer-style dashboard for your Mac. Talk or type, and Claude Code does the work with full tool access. Push-to-talk with local Whisper, spoken replies, a live arc-reactor orb and system readouts.

entry.title: 🌴 Pub Club Driving Game
entry.summary: A GTA 6-flavoured browser game: drive (and drift) around Vice Coast, find the flashing bars, drink, jack cars and try to survive the pub crawl. Works with keyboard or touch controls, all in one HTML file.

entry.title: 🏍️ Motorbike Tour Website
entry.summary: A one-page landing site for a 7-day off-road motorcycle expedition in Vietnam: itinerary, pricing and booking call-to-action.

entry.title: 🔊 Soundboks Sales Page
entry.summary: A single-product sales page (a $199 Soundboks 4 deal) with a hero image, specs and call-to-action. Use it as a quick template for selling one thing.

entry.title: 🗣️ Text to Speech
entry.summary: Free text-to-speech with natural Microsoft neural voices (falls back to the Mac's built-in voice offline), plus offline transcription of voice notes and recordings with Whisper.

entry.title: 🏛️ LLM Council
entry.summary: Put a big decision in front of 5 AI advisors who each think differently. They review each other's answers anonymously, then a chairman gives you one verdict showing where they agree and where they clash.

entry.title: 🔁 Recurring Task Setup
entry.summary: Before a recurring job ever runs, Claude writes a contract for it: the goal, the scope, a checker that proves it worked, a budget, and when to stop and ask you. Pairs with Pipeline QC.

entry.title: 🧠 Session Memory
entry.summary: Automatically turns finished Claude Code (and Codex) sessions into short, durable decision notes, so later you can ask 'what did we decide about X?' and get an answer.

entry.title: 🛰️ Multi-Source Search
entry.summary: When you ask Claude to 'check everywhere', it sends parallel searchers across repos, notes, drives and the web, then gives you ONE combined answer instead of searching one place at a time.

entry.title: 🧑‍🔧 Skill Curator
entry.summary: A weekly pass that mines your recent sessions for new reusable skills, tests and improves existing ones, archives dead ones and posts a digest.

entry.title: 📱 Website Icons
entry.summary: A checklist Claude follows on every website it builds: a favicon, a proper iPhone Add-to-Home-Screen icon, and the right meta tags. Includes a script that turns any emoji into all the icons in one command.
